sources.title: Most Common Last Names in England
sources.scope: Estimated surname bearer incidence in England; selected names from England-only published ranking
sources.limitations: Third-party modeled distribution, not official territorial census; surname particles and punctuation retained; incidence is never stored as weighting; redistribution permissions require separate review.

sources.title: Forebears surname list — england
sources.period: Forebears 2014 snapshot and historical 1881 census-derived list
sources.scope: Territorially grounded surnames from national or county published surname incidence rankings; 598 new distinct values retained. Counts used as evidence only and not copied into entries.
sources.limitations: Third-party modeled ranks and historical census-derived ranks; a county list documents residence in this country at the specified time, not ethnicity or etymological origin. Individual validation and reuse rights require pre-production review.
